votes.section: PLANNED DEVELOPMENT AMENDMENT- SUN RIVER COMMONS SIGNS
votes.motion: A motion was made by Commission Member Anderson to forward a positive recommendation to the City Council for the P-D Amendment for the Sun River Master Sign Plan. Amendment based on the findings and subject to the conditions listed in the staff report. Also, the conditions that they will not be adding electronic message signs on Arrowhead Canyon Drive and Bluegrass Way. The illumination of the 53 foot digital sign on the South will not exceed the current static illumination.

votes.section: PLANNED DEVELOPMENT AMENDMENT- SUN RIVER COMMONS SIGNS
votes.motion: A motion was made by Planning Commission Member Rogers to approve the Preliminary Plat for Chandler Heights.

votes.section: PLANNED DEVELOPMENT AMENDMENT- SUN RIVER COMMONS SIGNS
votes.motion: A motion was made by Planning Commission Member Anderson for a positive recommendation, item #3, the Hillside Development Permit for Chandler Heights.

votes.section: PLANNED DEVELOPMENT AMENDMENT- SUN RIVER COMMONS SIGNS
votes.motion: A motion was made by Planning Commission Member Fisher to recommend approval to City Council, item #4, the zone change as it’s presented with recommendations by staff with one restriction, as far as single family residences that are located on the North, that adjoin the neighborhood that is on the North side of this proposed development where the elevation is significant as it is, and concern and the risk, for safety purposes the ability to see down into people’s property and the height differences and what could be a safety risk as far as items thrown or discarded into their property, that the homes be limited to a single story at street level, which would allow for a basement beneath without any kind of height restriction for lots 11-21. And that the applicant be allowed, in the event that staff approves, that they are not required and can remove the additional parking on the road that encircles on the South side.
